Message:
One night, screams echoed
all through the village.

Daddy patted my head,
telling me,
“Everything’s gonna be okay.”

But, his hands felt a little shaky...
Mommy couldn’t stop
crying, either.

No, let’s go together!
I don’t wanna run away
by myself...!

Loud, harsh knocks pounded
again and again on our door.
If they kept going,
the door could break...!

Mommy and Daddy just
smiled warmly and led me
to the back door.

“Just remember, Shiloh.
Your smile can make
everyone happy. So...”

Those were Mommy’s
last words to me,
before they both shut the door.

No, I have to go...
I wanted to run back, but...

Remembering Mommy’s words,
I held back my tears...
and said goodbye with a smile.
